title: Zhang-2026-fine-10.1038/s41597-026-07619-z
description: This dataset contains electrocorticography (ECoG) recordings from patients at Huashan Hospital during speech perception in a tonal language (Mandarin). The signal is the 70-150 Hz high-gamma Hilbert envelope rather than raw voltage, converted from NWB to EDF in a BIDS-valid structure. It supports investigation of fine-grained spatiotemporal neural dynamics of tonal speech perception.
methods_description: Intracranial ECoG was recorded from participants during a speech perception task, with written informed consent obtained the day before surgery. The original NWB iEEG series were processed to a 70-150 Hz Hilbert high-gamma envelope and exported to EDF in microvolts, with round-trip conversion error reported per file.
